records.source: I brought some sparkling wine for the main event... Summer's not over yet!$0
records.translation: Nagdala ako ng alak na may bula para sa pangunahing kaganapan... Hindi pa tapos ang tag-init!$0

records.source: I would've brought us a pot of tea if I had known it would be this chilly!$0
records.translation: Nagdala sana ako ng isang palayok ng tsaa para sa atin kung alam kong magiging ganito kalamig!$0

records.source: I'm just spending some time with the family for a moment. I'll meet you on the docks soon, okay?$0
records.translation: Nakikisama lang ako sandali sa pamilya. Kikitain kita sa mga pantalan maya-maya, ha?$0

records.source: Wow... you look great tonight!$10
records.translation: Wow... napakaganda mo ngayong gabi!$10

records.source: Hi, honey. It'll be any moment now when the jellies show up... It never gets old!$0
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Anumang sandali ay lilitaw na ang mga dikya... Hindi nakasasawang makita ito!$0

records.source: Are you all prepared for the fall? I am...#$e#Huh? Oh, I bought a king size bag of pumpkin chips. You can have one, if you want.
records.translation: Handa ka na ba sa taglagas? Ako, handa na...#$e#Ha? Ah, bumili ako ng napakalaking supot ng tsitsiryang kalabasa. Maaari kang kumuha kung gusto mo.

records.source: I remember the first Moonlight Jellies festival that you came to.#$b#You didn't notice, but I was watching you when the jellies came up. You looked beautiful in that blue light...$l
records.translation: Naaalala ko ang unang Sayaw ng mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan na dinaluhan mo.#$b#Hindi mo napansin, pero pinagmamasdan kita nang lumapit ang mga dikya. Napakaganda mo sa asul na liwanag na iyon...$l

records.source: Ah, I was wondering when you would arrive!$0#$e#Let's head to the docks soon, and welcome our aquatic guests!$1
records.translation: Ah, iniisip ko kung kailan ka darating!$0#$e#Pumunta tayo sa mga pantalan maya-maya at salubungin ang mga panauhin natin mula sa tubig!$1

records.source: Apparently there's a rare green jelly. I want to be the first to see it tonight!$0
records.translation: May pambihirang berdeng dikya raw. Gusto kong ako ang unang makakita nito ngayong gabi!$0

records.source: Every year, I make sure to inspect the candle-boat, and patch any holes.#$e#Imagine if it sank during the festival...$1
records.translation: Bawat taon, sinusuri ko ang bangkang may kandila at tinatapalan ang anumang butas.#$e#Isipin mo na lang kung lumubog iyon sa gitna ng pista...$1

records.source: There's a different kind of 'jelly', that anglers sometimes pull out of the water. Despite the name, they are very different in nature to the Moonlight Jellies...
records.translation: May ibang uri ng 'dikya' na kung minsan ay nahuhuli ng mga mangingisda sa tubig. Sa kabila ng pangalan, lubhang naiiba ang kalikasan ng mga ito sa mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan...

records.source: Do you see a faint glow on the horizon? That must be them!$0
records.translation: May nakikita ka bang bahagyang liwanag sa abot-tanaw? Tiyak na sila iyon!$0

records.source: When you stare into the ocean, there's a chance something down there is looking back at you...$0
records.translation: Kapag tumitig ka sa karagatan, maaaring may bagay sa kailaliman na nakatitig din sa iyo...$0

records.source: I noticed no one else was using this dock, so I quietly snuck down.$0#$e#I like watching the jellies, too.
records.translation: Napansin kong walang ibang gumagamit ng pantalan na ito, kaya tahimik akong bumaba.$0#$e#Gusto ko ring pagmasdan ang mga dikya.

records.source: Hello, farmer @. Be sure to drop by my store tomorrow to purchase your fall seeds!$0
records.translation: Kumusta, magsasakang @. Tiyaking dumaan ka sa tindahan ko bukas para bumili ng mga binhi para sa taglagas!$0

records.source: I'm happy the jellies choose to visit us during their trip south. It's a magical moment our community can share together.$0
records.translation: Natutuwa akong pinipili ng mga dikya na dalawin tayo sa paglalakbay nila patimog. Isa itong mahiwagang sandaling maaaring pagsaluhan ng komunidad natin.$0

records.source: It's a shame that summer has to be over, but I guess that's life...$0
records.translation: Sayang at kailangang matapos ang tag-init, pero ganoon talaga ang buhay...$0

records.source: Back in the old days, we used to scoop 'em up and put 'em in jars...$h#$e#Times have changed... Times have changed...
records.translation: Noong unang panahon, sinasalok namin sila at inilalagay sa mga garapon...$h#$e#Nagbago na ang panahon... Nagbago na ang panahon...

records.source: George and I have been watching the jellies come and go together for decades now.$1
records.translation: Ilang dekada na naming pinagmamasdan ni George nang magkasama ang pagdating at paglisan ng mga dikya.$1

records.source: Greetings, @. As the evening sets in, the Moonlight Jellies draw closer to the shoreline.#$b#Once we set the candle-boat on its way, they'll gather around the docks.$0
records.translation: Magandang gabi, @. Habang lumalalim ang gabi, lumalapit sa baybayin ang mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan.#$b#Kapag pinakawalan na natin ang bangkang may kandila, magtitipon sila sa paligid ng mga pantalan.$0

records.source: I got too close to a wave, and it soaked my foot...$2
records.translation: Masyado akong lumapit sa alon at nabasa ang paa ko...$2

records.source: Brr... that's a chilly breeze. I should've worn a hat!
records.translation: Brr... malamig ang simoy. Dapat ay nagsuot ako ng sombrero!

records.source: Hey, kid. You're a farmer. So tell me... can you make jelly out of these things?#$e#Would save me a lot of money if I could top my toast that way!$1
records.translation: Hoy, bata. Magsasaka ka. Kung gayon, sabihin mo... makagagawa ka ba ng halaya mula sa mga bagay na ito?#$e#Malaki ang matitipid ko kung maipapahid ko iyon sa tinapay!$1

records.source: The moonlight jellies possess a deep blue aura of mystery...$0#$e#There's more to them than meets the eye.$0
records.translation: May malalim at asul na aura ng hiwaga ang mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan...$0#$e#Higit pa sila sa nakikita ng mata.$0

records.source: I didn't have time to put on makeup... Do you think anyone would notice in the dark?
records.translation: Wala akong oras para maglagay ng makeup... Sa tingin mo, may makapapansin sa dilim?

records.source: The full moon will guide the jellies to our shore.
records.translation: Gagabayan ng kabilugan ng buwan ang mga dikya patungo sa ating baybayin.

records.source: Hey. Got big plans for the fall?
records.translation: Hoy. May malalaki ka bang plano para sa taglagas?

records.source: I may only have one good eye left, but I assure you I will spot any fell creature lurking in the dark.
records.translation: Maaaring iisa na lang ang maayos kong mata, pero tinitiyak kong makikita ko ang anumang mabangis na nilalang na nagkukubli sa dilim.

records.source: Summer is drawing to a close. I'm gonna miss the long days!
records.translation: Patapos na ang tag-init. Hahanap-hanapin ko ang mahahabang araw!

records.source: Have any fun plans for the fall season? I need to decorate my house soon.
records.translation: May masasaya ka bang plano para sa taglagas? Kailangan ko nang palamutian ang bahay ko.

records.source: I wonder how many will show up this year?$0
records.translation: Ilan kaya ang lilitaw ngayong taon?$0

records.source: I can't go any further on the dock. The sounds of creaking wood is causing me to tremble.$s#$e#When I was a little girl, I fell through a rotten dock once, and it traumatized me...$s
records.translation: Hindi na ako makalakad pa sa pantalan. Nanginginig ako sa langitngit ng kahoy.$s#$e#Noong bata pa ako, minsan akong nahulog sa isang bulok na pantalan, at hindi ko na iyon malimutan...$s

records.source: The candle lights shimmering on the water are simply breathtaking. It looks like a painting coming to life.$0
records.translation: Talagang nakamamangha ang mga liwanag ng mga kandilang kumikislap sa tubig. Para itong larawang nabubuhay.$0

records.source: *sniff* Ahh... the fresh smell of the ocean never fails to satisfy.$0
records.translation: *singhot* Ahh... Hindi nakasasawa ang sariwang amoy ng karagatan.$0

records.source: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas? *napasinghap*#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: The glowing eggs of the Lunaloos make for a potent reagent...
records.translation: Mabisang sangkap sa mahika ang kumikislap na mga itlog ng mga Lunaloo...

records.source: With each passing second, my anticipation grows...$0
records.translation: Sa bawat segundong lumilipas, lalo akong nasasabik...$0

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: How do the jellies know where to swim if they don't have eyes?$0
records.translation: Paano nalalaman ng mga dikya kung saan lalangoy kung wala silang mata?$0

records.source: I touched a jelly once and it stung my hand.$2
records.translation: Minsan akong humawak ng dikya at nahapdi ang kamay ko.$2

records.source: It's an old fisherman's rule... if you ever fish up a moonlight jelly, you gotta throw her back into the sea.$0
records.translation: Matandang tuntunin ng mangingisda... kapag nakabingwit ka ng Dikyang Sinag-Buwan, kailangan mo siyang ibalik sa dagat.$0

records.source: My old friends from home are visiting us soon!$1
records.translation: Malapit na tayong dalawin ng matagal ko nang mga kaibigan mula sa aming tahanan!$1
